summary:
Scope: BAR1032 maintained source contract, not invocation or full acceptance. The dispatch-only hosted route has two closed purposes: full-image retains3600 work+120 retirement seconds, while network-prerequisite uses300+120 on the same4CPU/14GiB available/80GiB free/4096-task domain. No user duration, command, backend, retry or resumed store is introduced. The prerequisite never exports/loads/encrypts a candidate; its unused time is not another attempt. Full generation repeats fresh network qualification and still owes complete pinned toolchain/Recoil headers+engine archive/HighBar stock plugin+compiled controls/BAR Rapid game graph+map, static ELF identity, OCI export and separate-store load/readback.

A source composition defect was found before another dispatch:480 prep+3900 unit runtime+120 independent unit stop+1200 transport is5700 seconds, exceeding the5400-second job despite the inner3600+120 gate. Separate retirement layers cannot share one allowance. The new first-step producer requires three Root UTC inputs and one bounded first-attempt native job/source/runner read before checkout. It projects ONCE D=min(provider job start+5400,Root selection+5400) onto the original first-step boot/monotonic domain; queue, provider setup and metadata-read time consume D. Latest first-step is at most300 seconds after selection; the5700-second observer horizon gives no additional work. UTC skew is not independently authenticated. Malformed/late/Unknown joins refuse without automatic API retry. A private provenance-fenced startup stage can reach the existing single metadata uploader even without source checkout/helpers; unsafe pre-existing paths are not uploaded.

Independent source review rejected d63 because pre-unit provisioning could start near D and overrun it before unit admission. A first correction50d still omitted the separate free-toolchain/daemon/swap and volume bodies; they are now merged in their original order into the same fixed userland480 phase. All pre-unit run blocks are censused: initial clock, then controls300/userland480/admit300 under the closed preparation owner. First native job birth must not predate Root selection by more than1s of timestamp precision; together with first-step<=300 and the two checkout5min caps this bounds the pre-helper sequence. The first-step API/socket timeout is not a whole read deadline. Source now catches a whole15-second signal timer around initial validation/request/body and preserves its original refusal, then requires at least600 checkout+1200 transport+30 summary seconds remaining in D before checkout. No retry or fresh deadline is created. Each prep phase hard end is min(start+fixedMax,D-1200transport-30summary), with one second reserved for stop; the actual child rechecks boot/original clock/phase before the fixed body and GNUtimeout. The root parent drops the fixeduid1001 child, owns its born session/group and bounded pipes, and uses the SAME endpoint for TERM/KILL/wait/EOF. Bodies come only from the registered workflow; no arbitrary command/script/duration CLI exists. Receipts and bounded original stderr retain startup fallback provenance even before the volume exists.

Review also rejected leader-zero+EOF as group settlement. Already-observed non-Z birth-matched members block success, including moved PGID/SID; only a fresh original-group birth join grants group signalling, never an escaped new group. PermissionError/malformed proc custody stays Unknown and blocking. Confirmed absent/Z or different birthTicks settles that original execution observation only. Raw final state/start/PGID/SID readback uses the same fail-closed predicate as acceptance; final Unknown cannot silently pass. Whole escaped/unobserved descendants and provider disposal remain unproved, with no resource release inferred.

With L=D-1200 transport-120 independent unit stop-30 final summary, precreation Q selects R=min(3900,floor(L-Q-30 activation reserve)). The fixed root unit entry reads actual ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic U, invocation, mainPID/cgroup, type and fallback properties before namespace entry; U must lie within Q..Q+30 and U+R<=L. systemctl USec duration output is parsed as bounded human spans, not assumed raw integers. RuntimeMax is set only at transient creation: pinned systemd255 permits its transient setter only while UNIT_STUB, so active retiming is not a supported repair. After all wrapper preparation, the adjacent controller gate requires S+purposeWork+120 retirement+30 bookkeeping<=the same actual unit end<=L. Controller clock/purpose is validated in BAR input context; sharedSC2 remains unchanged. Old312.987-second preparation does not establish full-path fit under these margins. Source approval cannot assert native supplier fit.

Checkout bootstrap still removes only the proven fresh-checkout singleton local gc.auto0 and preserves other config. Root domain admission, strict complete source/pin closure, fresh VM/boot/stores, resource admission after base pull, fixed privateNET/PID/IPC/rootless/NNP/pasta/crun and loader/helper/AVX2/library closure remain. Parent/LSM observations retain Unknowns; failed proc access identifies an interface, not its sole denier. No host network, policy, capability or privilege bypass is selected.

Receipt9min, metadata1min and ciphertext10min share1200 seconds; final summary is bounded30 seconds. Optional diagnostics remain secondary; valid JSON1e999/NaN, missing/partial/failed data cannot skip original primary metadata. Expiry or candidate-only refusal cannot authorize transport or manufacture prerequisite success; safe original metadata remains available. Only a verified full candidate can enter CMS AES256GCM AuthEnvelopedData with RSAOAEP SHA256/MGF1SHA256; streaming is BER despite the DER CLI option. Original public recipient and OpenSSL/loader/library identity bind the original clock digest/deadline. Private key/decrypt/independent OCI receiver admission remain operator-only and separately owed.

Static actual producer/wrapper and closed-port checks were selected over a new model/general executor. Initial31 wrapper controls/two BAR preflight controls remain; correction42 controls and targeted owner/custody cases pass, including real inert bounded shell/Python/GNUtimeout groups, wait and EOF. Actual privileged preparation, systemd/container/crypto/toolchain/native image work did not run. Source rejections and original authoring/check observations remain retained. Full/native supplier fit is still Unknown; all failed original generations, retirement gaps and the historical source horizon overrun keep their original scopes. Full image, loaded ABI, gameplay, B2 and publication acceptance remain open.

Hosted source CI rejected the first deadline candidate before runtime: runner.temp is unavailable in jobs.<job>.env, although available in steps.env. STARTUP_EVIDENCE now resolves in the initial clock step and only the accepted path propagates through GITHUB_ENV; refusal retains its provenance-fenced step output for the existing metadata uploader. The original native failures and local Actionlint rejection remain retained. Four focused actual-producer, refusal/fallback and pin controls plus Actionlint/ShellCheck pass after this source correction. This validates expression placement and transport composition only; it does not establish hosted supplier fit, native preparation, full image acceptance or descendant retirement.
title: BAR preparation and known-group custody share one original deadline
